core_obligations: Let {X_i -> X} be an fppf covering; for affine U -> X base change to {X_i x_X U -> U}.
Refine by an fppf covering {T_i -> U} with T_i schemes via the refinement lemma.
Refine {T_i -> U} by a standard ph covering {U_j -> U} via the scheme-level lemma.
Conclude {X_i -> X} is a ph covering by definition (standard ph refinement over every affine chart); add the a-fortiori chain for the smaller topologies.
proof_roadmap: Base change to affine charts, scheme refinement, scheme-level fppf-to-ph, assemble the standard ph refinement.
difficulty_reason: The three-refinement chain is a real argument; each step uses a named input exactly.
